scope: Reconciliation of the saved October 28 audit snapshot. Original working files and other worktrees preserved. Subsequent work in concurrent sessions is not automatically included.
selection_status: Release verified live; unfinished features remain excluded.

features.request: Change an existing meeting date, including back to today
features.validation: 21 component tests and desktop/narrow Chrome interaction checks; frontend and backend public version endpoints both matched a60a975b8.

features.request: Keep Google sign-in on the same website
features.validation: 23 API-base routing tests; same-origin cookies retained.
5 pool-budget tests; production workflow limits preserved; proxy shell syntax checked.

features.request: Prevent duplicate recurring personal calendar holds after editing

features.validation: 5 backend and 6 frontend tests; newer guardian/enrollment safeguards preserved.

features.request: Clinical and Denver group membership and staff channel chat
features.validation: 45 focused tests. Read-only database verification confirmed scoped Clinical/Denver enrollment with full group sync disabled. No messages sent.

features.request: Offer meeting/evaluation times for invitees to reserve
features.validation: Real MySQL tests caught and fixed DISTINCT/ORDER BY and JSON key-order errors. Persistence, competing claims, idempotency, conflict rollback and closing unused holds verified. 4 real-DB tests, 50 unit cases, 10 screen tests. Production tables exist and contain no offers or pending deliveries.

features.request: Event clock reminders for app-only employees
features.validation: 7 priority-email tests; no real emails sent.

features.request: Quick navigation in the school portal
features.validation: Added the existing role-filtered Quick Nav control only for signed-in, non-preview school portals; retained newer Conversa labels. Vue compilation checked.

features.request: Disable archived/inactive accounts across login and recovery
features.validation: 74 account tests, 37 lifecycle tests including real MySQL, 18 frontend API tests passed. Production preflight found 9 conflicting flags, including one school account with a recorded October login. No account status changes made.
features.next_step: Reconcile whether each conflicting account should retain access before enforcing all flags.

features.request: School annual-update schedule, deadlines, and follow-up automation
features.validation: 56 tests pass, 1 DB test skipped. Code inspection found write access ignores rules.enabled and uses already-expired August defaults.
features.next_step: Honor disabled/legacy mode, validate the rollout cycle, and verify migration and notification behavior before enabling.

features.request: Telephone dial-in for meetings and supervision
features.validation: Dedicated Voice app/number, callback/signing secrets and real call pilot remain necessary.
features.next_step: Complete carrier setup and browser/phone audio, attendance and transcription pilot.

features.request: Shared SMS conversation ownership, drafts, topics, and separate lines
features.validation: 7 line-policy tests pass; conversation suite fails on a missing database mock export. New tables absent; main SMS line unset. Code disables history pagination and closes an episode before validating a new topic. Current Notifyre care-SMS restrictions retained.
features.next_step: Complete conversation tests and transactional topic/history behavior, apply tested schema, and validate configured main/provider lines.

features.request: Older support-email pilot, Finance Operations routes and scheduling lifecycle branches
features.validation: Patch-equivalent commits/routes found in main. Pilot variants would remove newer reply evidence, privacy, delivery, and mobile-layout fixes.

features.request: Old recovery snapshots and January stashes
features.validation: Historical copies predate the current implementation; no bulk merge or deletion performed.

features.request: Event analytics report scripts, generated PDFs, and local test configurations
features.validation: These are report/build/test artifacts, not unreleased website features.
